<!-- General -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{basePath}/assets/css/theme2.css?{versionKey}">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/styles.css }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/sfsites/c/resource/abcHeaderCSS?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/sfsites/c/resource/MyFavicon" />
<Style>
    
    .wtw-H{
        color:#000!important;
        text-align:center!important;
        font-size:2.25rem!important;
        font-weight:700!important
    }
    
    
    .card-style {
      background-color: #ffffff;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1px solid #eaeaea;
      box-shadow: 0px 12px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); 
      padding: 16px; 
    }

    .back-white{
     background-color: white;   
    }
    
    .back-grey{ 
        background-color: #f4f7fa; !important
    	font-size:2.25rem !important
    }
    
    .back-white{ background-color: #FFFFFF; !important}
    
    .border-rad{ border-radius: 10px }
    
    .responsive-Height{
        height: 100px;
    }
    .shop-all-btn:hover {
        background-color: #1175bc !important;
        color: white !important;
    }

    .book-card .btn-container {
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }
    .book-card:hover .btn-container {
        opacity: 1;
        visibility: visible;
    }

    .quick-shop-btn:hover {
        background-color: #eaf3fb !important;
    }

    /* Cart custom class */
    .my-cart-size {
        width: 90% !important;
        max-width: 90% !important;
    }
    
    [data-component-id="richTextEditor-cfd7"] {
    	min-width: fit-content;
        position: relative;
        right: 2.5rem;
	}
    
    /* ----------------- ----------------------------------------How To Order --------------------------------------------------------------- */
    	/* Desktop View (Default) */
    .book-grid {
        display: grid !important;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 130px) !important; /* Fixed 7 columns for desktop */
        gap: 20px !important;
        justify-content: start !important;
    }

    .spacer-div {
        display: block !important; /* Show Gap on Desktop */
        width: 130px;
    }

    /* Tablet View (Small Laptops & Tablets) */
    @media only screen and (max-width: 1024px) {
        .book-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px, 1fr)) !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
        }
        .spacer-div {
            display: none !important; /* No gap need on tablet view */
        }
    }

    /* Mobile View */
    @media only screen and (max-width: 480px) {
        .book-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important; /* Mobile par 2 books ek line mein */
            justify-items: center !important;
            gap: 15px !important;
        }
        .book-grid img {
            width: 140px !important; /* Mobile par thodi bari images */
        }
        .spacer-div {
            display: none !important;
        }
    }
    /*=============================================================================================================================*/
@media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
    .uiTabBar .tabs__nav, 
    .slds-tabs_default__nav,
    .tabs-list {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        height: auto !important;
        justify-content: space-around !important;
        padding: 10px 0 !important;
    }
    
    .slds-tabs_default__nav{width: 105% !important;}

    .uiTabBar .tabHeader, 
    .slds-tabs_default__item {
        flex: 0 0 45% !important; 
        margin: 5px 2% !important;
        text-align: center !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        display: inline-block !important;
        font-weight: normal !important; 
    }

    .uiTabBar .tabHeader.active,
    .slds-tabs_default__item.slds-is-active {
        background-color: #f3f2f1 !important;
        border: 1px solid #0070d2 !important;
        border-radius: 4px;
        font-weight: 600 !important; 
    }

    .slds-tabs_default__item.slds-is-active::after,
    .uiTabBar .active .tabHeader::after {
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    .slds-tabs_default__link, 
    .uiTabBar .tabHeader a {
        padding: 10px 5px !important;
        display: block !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .slds-icon_small {
    	width: 200% !important;
    	height: 100% !important;
}
    
    .dxp_layout-tab-bar > ul > li {width: 103%;}
}
</Style>
